notes: Thirty secondary problems per literature-standard family. mixer_split and insertships_routing must not be padded. target_heuristics are search/screen hints, not claims that main implements them.

subproblems.label: Euclidean TSP
subproblems.search_query: Euclidean traveling salesman nearest neighbor heuristic

subproblems.label: Asymmetric TSP
subproblems.definition: Directed distances, d(i,j) may differ from d(j,i).
subproblems.search_query: asymmetric traveling salesman ATSP nearest neighbor heuristic

subproblems.label: Metric TSP
subproblems.search_query: metric TSP approximation Christofides nearest neighbor

subproblems.label: Open TSP / Hamiltonian path
subproblems.definition: Path visits each city once, no return.
subproblems.search_query: open traveling salesman Hamiltonian path heuristic

subproblems.label: TSP with time windows
subproblems.search_query: TSP with time windows insertion heuristic

subproblems.label: Clustered TSP
subproblems.definition: Cities grouped; visit clusters as units.

subproblems.label: Generalized TSP
subproblems.definition: Visit exactly one city per cluster.

subproblems.label: Prize-collecting TSP
subproblems.definition: Optional cities with prizes and penalties.

subproblems.label: Orienteering / selective TSP
subproblems.definition: Max prize under a length budget.

subproblems.label: TSP with neighborhoods
subproblems.definition: Visit a region not a point.

subproblems.label: Large-scale Euclidean TSP
subproblems.search_query: large scale TSP Lin Kernighan heuristic

subproblems.label: Constructive-only TSP
subproblems.definition: Build a tour city by city.
subproblems.search_query: nearest neighbor cheapest insertion TSP constructive heuristic

subproblems.label: Capacitated VRP
subproblems.definition: One depot, capacity, visit each customer once.
subproblems.search_query: capacitated vehicle routing nearest neighbor Clarke Wright

subproblems.label: Multi-trip VRP
subproblems.definition: A vehicle may do several routes.

subproblems.label: Site-dependent VRP
subproblems.definition: Some vehicles cannot serve some sites.

subproblems.label: Constructive CVRP
subproblems.search_query: Clarke Wright savings nearest neighbor VRP constructive

subproblems.label: 1D online bin packing
subproblems.search_query: online bin packing First Fit Best Fit Harmonic

subproblems.label: 1D offline bin packing
subproblems.search_query: First Fit Decreasing Karmarkar Karp bin packing

subproblems.label: Harmonic online family
subproblems.search_query: Harmonic_M online bin packing Lee Lee

subproblems.label: Bounded-space online packing
subproblems.search_query: bounded space online bin packing heuristic

subproblems.label: Bin packing with conflicts
subproblems.definition: Some pairs cannot share a bin.

subproblems.label: Irrevocable online packing
subproblems.search_query: irrevocable online bin packing score function

subproblems.label: Best-Fit online family
subproblems.search_query: Best Fit online bin packing worst case Johnson

subproblems.label: Score-based online packing
subproblems.definition: Learned or designed score over residuals.
subproblems.search_query: online bin packing scoring heuristic residual

subproblems.label: Assignment knapsack
subproblems.definition: Assign items to agents with budgets.

subproblems.label: Order-greedy 0-1 (matches main Go solver)
subproblems.definition: Take items in file order if they fit.

subproblems.label: DP / FPTAS
subproblems.definition: Exact or approximate DP, not a constructive EoH elite.
